info_gain: 12 markets have lost a WNBA team since 1997; 4 (Portland 2026, Houston 2027, Cleveland 2028, Detroit 2029) are getting one back
Houston's 18 seasons without a team are the shortest of the four returns
8 of the 29 WNBA titles from 1997 to 2025 were won in cities that later lost their team; 7 of those were in Houston and Detroit, which both get teams back
Orlando/Connecticut/Houston becomes the third WNBA franchise to move twice
Mohegan's 2003 WNBA expansion fee was $10,000,000 (SEC filing); the 2026 sale brings Mohegan $300 million (30x, before inflation)

unique: Every WNBA market that lost a team, with seasons without a team and titles won there (CC0 CSV)
2003 expansion fee from SEC exhibit vs. 2026 sale proceeds
